about: Generation prompts for the 3D book's sound layer (scripts/sfx/generate.mjs). seconds = duration_seconds (0.5-30; shorter sounds are generated at 0.5-0.6 s and trimmed when mastering), influence = prompt_influence (0-1), takes = how many to generate for selection. kind sfx -> POST /v1/sound-generation, kind music -> POST /v1/music (lengthMs >= 3000). `sets` list the runs; a set entry may override model and takes.
